name: claude-usage-bar
description: Shows Claude Code 5-hour and 7-day usage limits and context usage in the VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Claude Usage Bar: Check for updates

claudeUsageBar.limitWarning.description: 5h/7d percentage at which the text turns yellow.

claudeUsageBar.limitCritical.description: 5h/7d percentage at which the text turns red.

claudeUsageBar.contextWarning.description: Context percentage at which the text turns yellow.

claudeUsageBar.contextCritical.description: Context percentage at which the text turns red.

claudeUsageBar.contextHideAfterMinutes.description: Hide context usage when no Claude tab is open and the last session has been idle for this many minutes.

claudeUsageBar.contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens. 0 detects it from the model.

claudeUsageBar.checkForUpdates.description: Check GitHub Releases once a day and offer to install new versions.
